name: RDB40
desc: A ceiling-mounted indoor access point on MediaTek MT7628 with 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, integrated BLE 6.0 with long-range FEM, and 802.3af PoE IN. Designed for indoor asset tracking, smart building sensor aggregation, and single-cable Wi-Fi access point deployment.
dims: 190 x 190 x 40 mm (W x D x H)
use_cases: Indoor Asset Tracking & Real-Time Location Services (RTLS)
Single-Cable PoE Indoor Wi-Fi Access Point Deployment
